problem.title: K-pop selling moves too fast for scattered tools
items: Google Forms for album GOs and claims
Spreadsheets for slots, stock, and buyer balances
DMs for payment confirmations and address changes
Screenshots for every photocard, set, and proof
problem.escalation: And it gets worse with every drop.
painPoints: Manual slot checks after every claim
Endless DM scrolling during comeback week
problem.outro: That works for one tiny batch. It breaks the moment a drop gets real.

solution.title: One clean K-pop storefront for every drop
items: A storefront for albums, photocards, lightsticks, and fan-made merch
Buyers claim and order directly — no form juggling
Payment proofs uploaded on the order, not buried in DMs
Statuses for every order, from pending payment to shipped
solution.outro: Run the drop from one place, even when the fandom shows up all at once.

items.question: Do I need a payment gateway?
items.answer: No — buyers upload proof of payment manually. Bank transfer, Wise, PayPal, whatever you already use.

items.question: Can I sell photocards, not just full group orders?
items.answer: Yes — Bias Market is built for album GOs, individual photocard claims, set splits, and fan merch drops.

items.question: Is this free?
items.answer: Free for early sellers while we build out the product.
